### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template: `DATA_ROOT` is the results directory given to `depictio ingest`, the others are set with `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | mcmicro output directory (registration/, backsub/, segmentation/, quantification/mcquant/, prelude/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | The samplesheet the run was started with (--input_cycle: sample, cycle_number, image_tiles; or --input_sample), plus any design columns. Defaults to input/samplesheet.csv under DATA_ROOT. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Samplesheet id column. mcmicro fixes it to sample; recorded for the metadata auto-detection. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Samplesheet column the dashboard groups and filters images by. Defaults to cycles (the cycle count of the sample, derived from the sheet); name any design column added to the sheet instead. |
| `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY` | — | Reader-facing label of GROUP_COL, used in filter and card titles. |
| `MARKER_SHEET` | — | The marker sheet the run was started with (--marker_sheet: channel_number, cycle_number, marker_name, optional background, exposure, remove). Defaults to input/markers.csv under DATA_ROOT. |
| `PREVIEW_S3_FOLDER` | — | S3 folder the PNG previews are uploaded to and served from: a folder in the server's own bucket, one per run so two runs never overwrite each other's previews. |
| `SINGLE_SEGMENTER` | — | Set (--var SINGLE_SEGMENTER=true) for a run with one method in --segmentation (the pipeline's default, mesmer): nothing to compare, so the segmenter agreement collection is removed. |

### Conditional routes

Rows are data collections; columns are the variables you set or `params.json` flags auto-detected from the run. Each filled cell is the effect of **setting** that variable; an **empty cell** means that variable leaves the collection unchanged. (9 collections are unaffected by any variable — present on every run.)

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`mcquant/cell_markers.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mcquant/cell_markers.py) | Marker intensities of every cell, one row per cell and marker (MCQUANT, long). | `cell_key`, `sample`, `segmenter`, `CellID`, `marker`, `marker_order`, `marker_role`, `intensity`, `asinh_intensity` |
| [`mcquant/cells.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mcquant/cells.py) | Every segmented cell of an nf-core/mcmicro run, one row per cell (MCQUANT, wide). | `cell_key`, `sample`, `segmenter`, `CellID`, `X_centroid`, `Y_centroid`, `Area`, `MajorAxisLength`, `MinorAxisLength`, `Eccentricity`, `Solidity`, `Extent`, `Orientation`, `aspect_ratio` |
| [`mcquant/marker_correlation.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mcquant/marker_correlation.py) | How the markers co-vary over the cells, per segmenter (MCQUANT). | `marker_row`, `segmenter`, `marker`, `marker_role` |
| [`mcquant/marker_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mcquant/marker_summary.py) | Marker intensity per image, segmenter and marker (MCQUANT). | `summary_key`, `sample`, `segmenter`, `marker`, `marker_order`, `marker_role`, `n_cells`, `mean_intensity`, `median_intensity`, `q1_intensity`, `q3_intensity`, `median_asinh`, `cv` |
| [`mcquant/segmentation_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mcquant/segmentation_summary.py) | Cells and their sizes per image and segmenter (MCQUANT). | `summary_key`, `sample`, `segmenter`, `n_cells`, `median_area`, `q1_area`, `q3_area`, `mean_area`, `total_area`, `median_major_axis`, `median_eccentricity`, `median_solidity`, `median_aspect_ratio` |
| [`mcquant/segmenter_agreement.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mcquant/segmenter_agreement.py) | How far two segmentation methods agree on the same image (MCQUANT). | `pair_key`, `sample`, `segmenter`, `other_segmenter`, `pair`, `n_cells`, `other_cells`, `count_ratio`, `cells_holding_other`, `matched_share`, `median_held` |
| [`nf-core/mcmicro/markers.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/mcmicro/recipes/markers.py) | The marker panel of an nf-core/mcmicro run: one row per channel of the marker sheet. | `marker_name`, `channel_number`, `cycle_number`, `marker_role`, `status`, `quantified`, `background`, `background_subtracted`, `exposure`, `filter`, `excitation_wavelength`, `emission_wavelength` |
| [`nf-core/mcmicro/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/mcmicro/recipes/samples.py) | Sample hub for nf-core/mcmicro: one row per sample (one image to register). | `sample`, `cycle_count`, `cycles`, `image_files` |
